# يُسْتَقْطَبُ (yustaqṭabu) /jus.taq.tˤa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# يَسْتَقْطِبَ (yastaqṭiba) /jas.taq.tˤi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْ
